subject: EXIT statement
notes: BOTH sentences of GR2 are implemented, and both are covered by spec-derived tests. Sentence 1 (CONTINUE in a non-called program): EmitExitProgram emits `if (__asCalled) throw new ProgramReturn();` for the plain form, so with no activation nothing at all happens and control falls to the next statement - CallDifferentialTests.ExitProgram_InMainProgram_IsContinue is AssertSpecPinned (BEFORE/AFTER) and its own doc-comment records that the legacy oracle deviates here, so the expectation is computed from the rule, not from the oracle. Sentence 2 ('No exception condition is raised even if the RAISING phrase is specified'): the RAISING form puts BOTH the EmitRaisingStage call AND the ProgramReturn throw inside one `if (__asCalled)` block, so a main-program EXIT PROGRAM RAISING stages nothing - ExceptionConditionConformanceTests.ExitProgramRaising_InMainProgram_IsContinue raises EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW under >>TURN EC-SIZE CHECKING ON and asserts the sole output FELL-THROUGH. The 'not under the control of a calling runtime element' predicate is the per-activation __asCalled flag (ProgramEmitter), which is the CALL-activation state the rule names, not a static main/subprogram property.  || CODE SITES (verbatim from the adjudication, kept because the schema's code-location is symbol-keyed, not line-keyed): src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Verbs/CallEmitter.cs#EmitExitProgram; src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/ProgramEmitter.cs
